rv.q: Odella (Adeola Role) has buried her beloved Freddy, whom she still mourns, and now she must bury her sister. Fourteen-year-old Sadie (the staggeringly good KiKi Layne) has lost her mother, and won’t say a word to anyone.

An avoidance of stark reality marks her often immediately involving works. Indeed, On Sugarland begins in surreal fashion when 14-year-old Sadie (Kiki Layne) steps into designer Amith Chandrashaker’s solo light and declares, “I can make the dead walk.” Hard not to pay attention to a play beginning that way.
